task: Write the FIRST cart-abandonment email (subject + preview + body) for a premium magnesium glycinate brand. Goal: recover the sale within ~1 hour of abandonment. Must be on-brand premium, address the abandonment reason, and have one clear CTA — not pushy spam.
reference: Excellent = subject line that earns the open without screaming discount (curiosity/benefit/helpful), short preview text that complements it, a body that reminds them what's in the cart, handles the most likely hesitation (is it worth it / will it work / trust) with a specific proof or guarantee, ONE clear CTA back to the cart, premium restrained tone, and a soft P.S. — no fake urgency, no immediate desperate discount on email #1. Bad = ALL-CAPS spammy subject, leads with a big blunt discount, generic 'you left something behind' with no value, multiple competing CTAs, pushy fake-urgency, off-brand.
